_readme: DOCUMENT LIBRARY. To add a document: (1) store the file — either in public/documents/ or in its own GitHub repository — then (2) add an entry below. Use 'file' for a path inside public/, or 'url' for a document hosted elsewhere, optionally with 'repository' for a link to that repository. It appears in the library automatically. Set 'private' to true for anything that must stay off the public site — the entry is then removed from the library entirely (but remember: any file in public/ is still publicly reachable by direct URL, so leave such files out of the repository altogether).
intro: Academic documents are grouped by type and open on GitHub, where each project keeps its own repository. Your resume is served directly from this site.
_categories: Category labels used by the filter. Remove a category here and its filter option disappears.
